description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of the EffectedSubjectIds interface, representing sets of subject IDs with granted and revoked permissions. It includes factory methods, a builder pattern for mutable construction, and overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds
classes.description: An immutable class implementing EffectedSubjectIds, encapsulating sets of granted and revoked subject IDs with various factory methods and a builder for construction.

classes.name: EffectedSubjectIds
classes.description: The interface that ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds implements (assumed to define getGranted() and getRevoked()).

classes.name: ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds.Builder
classes.description: A static nested mutable builder class providing fluent methods to construct an ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds instance with specified granted and revoked subject ID collections.

methods.name: ofGranted
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance with only granted subject IDs.

methods.name: ofRevoked
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance with only revoked subject IDs.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new Builder instance for constructing ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns the set of granted subject IDs.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns the set of revoked subject IDs.
